narrative.overview: TEAMFORGE is a working desk, not a showcase. The surface is built so an operations lead can read the organization's pulse, find the one thing that needs a human, and act without decoding a new interface. Familiar Ant Design patterns carry the interaction; the identity comes from restraint, a deep ink navigation rail, and a single azure signal that marks action and current position.
keyCharacteristics: Ant Design v6 as the component language, themed through tokens rather than overridden CSS.
A 248px deep-ink navigation rail against a light three-layer surface model.
Azure #1677FF as the only action/selection accent; semantic colours only for state.
Flat-by-default surfaces with 1px hairline borders; shadows reserved for floating layers.
A functional ⌘K command palette as the signature interaction.

rules.name: The One Azure Rule
rules.body: Azure is spent on action, current selection, and data focus only. It is never a decorative background, a chart series by default, or a second brand colour.

rules.name: The Text Plus Colour Rule
rules.body: Status is never encoded by colour alone. Every health, priority, and approval state carries a written label beside its tint.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts and metrics use tabular numerals so columns and metric bands never shift as values change.

rules.name: The No-Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code, identifiers, and measured data. It never stands in for technical styling on labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If a surface is not floating, it earns a 1px border instead of a shadow. A zero-offset coloured halo is never depth.

dos: Do use Ant Design components and theme tokens; change the system through ConfigProvider, not one-off CSS.
Do keep azure for action, current selection, and focus only.
Do put a written label beside every status colour.
Do show loading, empty, error, hover, focus, and disabled states.
Do keep table rows and custom clickable surfaces keyboard-focusable.
Do use monospace only for IDs, predicates, room names, and measured data.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour or a decorative gradient.
Don't add shadows to resting cards; use hairlines and tonal layers.
Don't use a hero-metric template or a grid of identical icon cards as page structure.
Don't use coloured left borders above 1px on cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't encode health or priority with colour alone.
Don't set body or placeholder text below 4.5:1 contrast.
Don't hide the primary action behind a modal when an inline form will do.
Don't invent activity, metrics, or agent claims to fill an empty state.
